steps.comment: 1. This is a normal vLLM server. The command you already run:
2. This is the SpeedLM vLLM -- verbatim from the script that ran it:
Same model, same vLLM flags. One new thing: --enable-idle-tuning.
Everything below reads ONE real completed run, already on disk:
3. Here is us giving it prompts. Real captured turns, verbatim:
steps.command: python3 -c "import json;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open('$T')];W=lambda s,n:' '.join((s or '').split())[:n];S={};_=[S.setdefault(r['messages'][-2]['content'][:40],r) for r in R if len(r['messages'])==3];_=[print('user  >',W(r['messages'][-2]['content'],88)+chr(10)+'model > '+('tool_call '+r['tool_calls'][0]['function']['name']+'('+W(r['tool_calls'][0]['function']['arguments'],46)+')' if r.get('tool_calls') else W(r['messages'][-1].get('content'),88))+chr(10)) for r in list(S.values())[:3]]"

steps.comment: 4. Then, here is us stopping. The client goes away:
steps.command: python3 -c "import json,datetime as D;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open('$T')];t=max(float(r['timestamp']) for r in R);print('%d requests captured. last one at %s. then: nothing.'%(len(R),D.datetime.fromtimestamp(t).strftime('%H:%M:%S')))"

steps.comment: 5. Shortly after that last request the idle threshold trips, on its own:
6. It trains a draft head on that traffic. Real optimizer steps:
steps.command: awk 'match($0,/train.loss=[0-9.]+/){L=substr($0,RSTART+11,RLENGTH-11)} match($0,/global_step=[0-9]+/){N=substr($0,RSTART+12,RLENGTH-12)+0; if(N%120==0)printf "  step %-3d   train/loss = %s\n",N,L} match($0,/val.loss_epoch=[0-9.]+/){E++;printf "  EPOCH %d    val/loss_epoch = %s\n",E,substr($0,RSTART+15,RLENGTH-15)}' $C/training-logs/stdout.log

steps.comment: 10.9 down to 0.06 over 8 epochs. But a lower loss is not a faster server. So:
7. It benchmarks itself before it trusts the result:
steps.command: jq -r '"held-out contexts     \(.num_contexts)  (session-disjoint: none seen in the training window)", "repeats per arm       \(.num_repeats), max_tokens=\(.benchmark_max_tokens), warmup=\(.warmup_repeats)", "stock baseline        \(.stock_draft)", "promote only if       \(.acceptance_criterion)", "thresholds            length >= \(.min_accepted_length_delta), acceptance >= \(.min_acceptance_delta_pp)pp, tok/s >= \(.min_throughput_delta_pct)%"' $D/decision.json

steps.comment: 8. The head it just trained vs the stock draft head, on that suite:
steps.command: jq -r 'def r4:(.*10000|round/10000); def r3:(.*1000|round/1000); def r2:(.*100|round/100); def r1:(.*10|round/10); def pc1:((.*10|round) as $t|"\($t/10|floor).\($t%10)"); def p(n):(tostring+"            ")[0:n]; def dl:[.per_repeat[]|(.candidate_tok_per_sec/.stock_tok_per_sec-1)*100|r1]; "                      \("tuned"|p(11))\("stock"|p(11))delta", "accepted length       \(.candidate_avg_accepted_length|r4|p(11))\(.stock_avg_accepted_length|r4|p(11))+\(.accepted_length_delta|r4)  (SE \(.accepted_length_delta_standard_error|r4))", "                                             = +\(.accepted_length_delta/.stock_avg_accepted_length*100|pc1)% more tokens accepted per step", "acceptance rate       \(.candidate_avg_acceptance|r3|p(11))\(.stock_avg_acceptance|r3|p(11))+\(.acceptance_delta_pp|r2)pp  (SE \(.acceptance_delta_standard_error_pp|r2)pp)", "decode tok/s          \(.candidate_avg_tok_per_sec|r2|p(11))\(.stock_avg_tok_per_sec|r2|p(11))+\(dl|min|pc1)% to +\(dl|max|pc1)% across repeats", "", "identical outputs     \(.divergence_trials - .output_total_divergences) / \(.divergence_trials) greedy trials  (\(.output_total_divergences) divergences)", "gate verdict          \(.final_verdict // .verdict), vetoed on \(.final_reason // .reason) -- that is the", "                      throughput channel; accepted length passed at +\(.accepted_length_delta|r4)."' $D/decision.json

steps.comment: And it is not a one-off. Three independent gates of this same head:
steps.command: jq -r 'def r4:(.*10000|round/10000); "  \(input_filename|split("/")|.[4]|(.+"              ")[0:16])\(.num_contexts) contexts x \(.num_repeats) repeats   accepted length +\(.accepted_length_delta|r4)"' $C/decision.json $G $D/decision.json

steps.comment: One idle window, no operator: +15.0% more tokens accepted per verifier step.
